name: "{Recipient}s are hard to gift.." + POV gift handoff
status: PROVEN: produced the #1 reel (6.6M). External confirmation on new recipients (kids 374K from a 553-follower account; dad 2.7M).
summary: A quoted complaint ('Women are hard to gift..') over a POV from the couch/bed: the recipient's legs in the foreground, a man steps in and hands over the branded gift box. Then the wearable body.
why: #1 reel on any page: 6.6M, opener verified as gen 3ac3e05b (recreate a viral handoff, swap blue box → green box) (hf_match row 1).
POV_HANDOFF opener: 2/3 fresh posts ≥50K, median 165K (hooks REPORT §1.4).
Same text with an in-store mom+daughter reaction: 304K and 101K (identical file 11 days apart; repost won).
External: cyber.gun1 '"Kids are hard to gift" 🎄🔫' 374K from 553 followers, 1,721 shares; kateeeeeeeeee22 dad gift ideas 2.7M (V; X).

shots.content: POV from couch: her legs lower third; bearded man in a sweater steps in and hands the {brand} gift box down toward camera; her hands reach in by ~2 s
talent slips the {product} on, turned away with her back to the phone, hood up so the hood design is what the phone sees
open it wide: white sherpa lining, step into the foot pouch (legs view); the B1→B2 boundary is the jump cut
macro: USB / power-bank clicks into the port in the fur
shots.text: JK flip lands exactly here on store hooks

shots.content: POV thumb presses the controller, LED heat levels climb
reclined on couch/bed, fully inside, hood up, eyes close / smile, tree lights behind; CUT MID-ACTION

measured: 6.7K 'Mom's are hard to gift..' (re-render, face cropped): 3.300 | 5.100 | 8.267 | 9.100 | 10.667 | END 12.61 — same timing as the 6.6M, so timing is not the cause.
rules: The box must be in frame and moving toward camera by 2 s.
Keep the recipient's face out of the hook (POV legs); the giver's face smiles.

text.style: In quotation marks, two trailing dots, NO emoji on the main line (6.6M, 304K, 101K). House placement.
rules: 'Mom's are hard to gift..' at 6.7K was a 1080p re-render with the face cropped; wording is not proven worse.
